episode.text:
Aditya,

Quick heads-up on the UPI flow, as promised yesterday: I'm not waiting for Monday.

I submitted the Razorpay merchant KYC for UPI autopay mandates this morning. Their support just confirmed it takes five business days for sandbox mandate activation, not three. That puts the unlock on Thursday the 24th at the earliest, and I need two full days after that to test mandates against real callbacks.

So I'm moving the UPI flow from Friday the 25th to Monday the 28th. The one-time UPI path already works and will be on staging by Friday the 25th regardless; this move is only about mandates.

Rahul, cc'ing you because your shell tests against staging, not against my branch, so your dates don't change.

Priya

thread.subject: Orbit navigation: side drawer vs accessibility checklist

episode.text:
Dear Rahul,

Thank you for checking before building; most vendors do not.

1. 56 dp is a hard minimum (checklist section 4.2, Primary navigation targets). It comes from our field study with gloved agents and is not negotiable for the pilot.
2. Yes. A side drawer satisfies section 4.5 provided the trigger is at least 56 dp, the drawer is announced as Navigation to TalkBack, and focus moves into the drawer when it opens. Your mockup does all three.

Please consider the drawer mockup approved by Meridian Bank compliance as of today. The tab bar proposal would not have passed.

We will have further items for the payment flows on the call on the 23rd with Aditya and Priya.

Kind regards,
Farah Siddiqui
Compliance, Meridian Bank
